positions.title: UX Designer
positions.description: UXU is a registered student organization that helps students learn more about UX design and provide them with tools to grow as designers, network within the tech industry, and advance along their career path. At UXU, we focus working with other members to create inside their design toolkit of choice (Figma, Sketch, Adobe xD, Framer, Principle).

projects.title: GrubRun
projects.description: Using the Yelp API and FireBase to create the main features of this web application, my team created a resource to find the nearest restaurants to you. Relying on skills taught during this school quarter, my team of five was able to use React, Bootstrap, and other supporting frameworks to create a fluid and eye-catching UI. In terms of responsibilities, I took charge in converting our original HTML and CSS-created UI into React. Additionally, I implemented FireBase to let users create accounts for persistent data when saving their favorite restaurants.

projects.title: Alarm Learning Android App
projects.description: For the final project of my Android development class at UW, I collaborated with a team to make an alarm app. This alarm app allowed the user to set an alarm at a certain time or randomly between a certain time slot. The latter functionality was inspired by the fact that studies have shown that people tend to learn better when they are reminded to do something daily, no matter what time. The element of randomness helps the user jog their memory by making the task seem to not be a set chore. We also implemented the application to create alarms based on location, so when they're in a certain location they get a notification. I contributed largely to this application by implementing the core feature, which were the random and set alarms, as well as the UI. I made use of third party libraries and Android's documentation to make this app compatible for all API levels.
